author: nickyeow

english.text: Did you call him up yesterday?

jyutping: nei5 cam4 jat6 jau5 mou4 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 keoi5？
text: 你尋日有無打電話俾佢？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I always liked mysterious characters more.

jyutping: ngo5 bat1 lau1 dou1 zung1 ji3 di1 san4 bei3 di1 ge3 jan4 mat6。
text: 我不嬲都鍾意啲神秘啲嘅人物。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The Alpinists carried out the ascent, but they did not return safely.

jyutping: go2 baan1 jan4 sing4 gung1 gam2 paa4 zo2 soeng5 saan1 deng2，daan6 hai6 faan1 lai4 go2 zan6 zau6 ceot1 zo2 si6。
text: 嗰班人成功噉爬咗上山頂，但係返嚟嗰陣就出咗事。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I spend what time I can spare reading.

jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 hung1 haan4 si4 gaan3 kam2 baan6 laan6 lo2 saai3 lai4 tai2 syu1。
text: 我將啲空閒時間冚辦爛攞晒嚟睇書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He's always looking at you.

jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mong6 zyu6 nei5。
text: 佢成日都望住你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't have a ticket.

jyutping: ngo5 mou5 fei1。
text: 我冇飛。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please remember to wake me up at six tomorrow morning.

jyutping: gei3 zyu6 ting1 ziu1 luk6 dim2 giu3 ngo5 hei2 san1 wo3。
text: 記住聽朝六點叫我起身喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I like playing tennis.

jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 daa2 mong5 kau4。
text: 我鍾意打網球。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She is a woman of great beauty.

jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 neoi5 jan2。
text: 佢係一個好靚嘅女人。

author: dngzz1

english.text: Please forget what we talked about earlier.

jyutping: zau6 dong1 ngo5 dei6 zi1 cin4 mou5 gong2 gwo3 laa1。
text: 就當我哋之前冇講過啦。

author: kaenif

english.text: What's that sound?

jyutping: me1 seng1 lai4？
text: 咩聲嚟？

author: kaenif

english.text: I want a doctor.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 ji1 sang1。
text: 我想要醫生。

author: nickyeow

english.text: When you travel abroad, you need change in the currency of the country you are visiting to pay for a taxi, a cup of coffee or a tip.

jyutping: heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 leoi5 hang4 jiu3 daai3 ding6 jan4 dei6 fo3 bai6 ge3 saan2 zi2，lo2 lai4 fei1 dik1、taan3 gaa3 fe1、bei2 tip1 si2。
text: 去外國旅行要帶定人哋貨幣嘅散紙，攞嚟飛的、嘆咖啡、俾貼士。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We have time to sing one more song.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gau3 si4 gaan1 coeng3 do1 jat1 sau2 go1。
text: 我哋夠時間唱多一首歌。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How did you celebrate Christmas last year?

jyutping: nei5 gau6 nin2 dim2 hing3 zuk1 sing3 daan3 aa3？
text: 你舊年點慶祝聖誕呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want to go to bed early tonight.

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan1 soeng2 zou2 di1 fan3。
text: 我今晚想早啲瞓。

author: nickyeow

english.text: When can we have a discussion about this?

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gei2 si4 ho2 ji5 king1 haa5 ni1 joeng2 je5 aa3？
text: 我哋幾時可以傾吓呢樣嘢呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Why are you crying? Did I say something I shouldn't have?" "No, it's just that a drop of sweat got into my eye."

jyutping: 「nei5 zou6 me1 haam3 aa3？ngo5 hai6 mai6 gong2 co3 je5 aa3？」「m4 hai6 aa3，jau5 dik6 hon6 jap6 zo2 ngaan5 zaa3。」
text: 「你做咩喊呀？我係咪講錯嘢呀？」「唔係呀，有滴汗入咗眼咋。」

author: aizilan

english.text: It's so big!

jyutping: hou2 daai6 wo3！
text: 好大喎！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Be serious.

jyutping: mai5 waan2 laa1。
text: 咪玩啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He told me that he's ready.

jyutping: keoi5 tung4 ngo5 gong2 waa6 keoi5 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 laak3。
text: 佢同我講話佢已經準備好嘞。

author: cheeseisdisgusting

english.text: She's in a meeting right now.

jyutping: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hoi1 gan2 wui6 aa3。
text: 佢而家開緊會啊。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I have been walking for over four hours.

jyutping: ngo5 haang4 zo2 sei3 go3 zung1 jau5 do1。
text: 我行咗四個鐘有多。

english.text: It was a spacious harbour, sheltered deep / from access of the winds, but looming vast / with awful ravage, AEtna's neighbouring steep / thundered aloud, and, dark with clouds, upcast / smoke and red cinders in a whirlwind's blast. / Live balls of flame, with showers of sparks, upflew / and licked the stars, and in combustion massed, / torn rocks, her ragged entrails, molten new, / the rumbling mount belched forth from out the boiling stew.

jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 fun1 cong2 ge3 gong2 hau2，ze1 bai3 dak1 hou2 sam1 / bei6 hoi1 saai3 di1 fung1，daan6 hai6 lai4 gan2 hou2 gwong2 fut3 / jau5 ho2 paa3 ge3 po3 waai6， AEtna ge3 leon4 gan6 dau2 ciu3 / daai6 daai6 seng1 leoi4 ming4，ji4 ce2，haak1 am3 jau5 wan4，hoeng3 soeng6 / jin1 mou6 tung4 hung4 sik1 ge3 fui1 zeon2 hai2 syun4 fung1 ge3 baau3 zaa3 fo2 jim6，daai3 maai4 di1 fo2 faa1，fei1 hei2 / tung4 tim2 sing1 sing1，ji4 hai2 jin4 siu1 jap6 min6， / si1 lit6 ge3 ngaam4 sek6， keoi5 di1 po3 laan6 ge3 noi6 zong6，jung4 faa3 zo2 san1 ge3， / go3 lung4 lung4 ge3 saan1 cung4 gwan2 gwan2 ge3 dan6 juk6 jap6 min6 tou3 ceot1 lai4。
text: 呢個係一個寬敞嘅港口，遮蔽得好深 / 避開晒啲風，但係嚟緊好廣闊 / 有可怕嘅破壞， AEtna 嘅鄰近陡峭 / 大大聲雷鳴，而且，黑暗有雲，向上 / 煙霧同紅色嘅灰燼喺旋風嘅爆炸火焰，帶埋啲火花，飛起 / 同舔星星，而喺燃燒入面， / 撕裂嘅岩石， 佢啲破爛嘅內臟，融化咗新嘅， / 個隆隆嘅山從滾滾嘅燉肉入面吐出嚟。
